entry.title: Macro Osc 1.1.1
entry.summary: Macro Osc: a macro oscillator with 47 synthesis models, from Émilie Gillet's open-source Braids. ## What's new in 1.1.1 Built on sd88me's fixed wrapper ([mpc-vst-plugins#499](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins/discussions/499)): on track edit → automation, the physical Q-Links move this plugin's parameters again (before, they didn't move or snapped straight back). Controls that change others, such as a preset, still redraw the screen. Nothing else changed: same parameters, sound and scree

entry.title: Macro Osc 1.1.0
entry.summary: Macro Osc: a macro oscillator with 47 synthesis models, from Émilie Gillet's open-source Braids. ## What's new in 1.1.0 - **New name: Macro Osc** (was Braids). Mutable Instruments asks that its name and its module names not be used on derivative works, so the plugin has a name of its own and shows **Émilie Gillet**, who wrote the code, as its maker. Its sound is unchanged: Émilie Gillet's open-source Braids code. - The screen no longer shows another company's name. - Parameters are unchanged, so
